Josias Bahena, a drill instructor with Bravo Company, 1st Recruit Training Battalion, instructs recruits to move faster during pick up at Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego, Calif., March 25, 2016. Pick up was the first encounter the recruits have with the drill instructors who are charged with the responsibility of transforming the recruits to basically-trained Marines. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by LCpl Angelica Annastas)

gallery.title: File:Calm before the Storm (19893537595).jpg
gallery.artist: Marines from Arlington, VA, United States
gallery.description:
Sgt. Donald Jackson, a drill instructor from Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego, trains Marine enlistees discipline during a Recruiting Station Seattle pool function at the Yakima Training Center in Yakima, Washington, July 17, 2015. During the event, recruiters teamed with drill instructors to physically and mentally prepare enlistees from Washington and Idaho for boot camp. The enlistees, part of the Marine Corps delayed entry program, are awaiting their ship dates. Jackson, 28, is from Suffolk, Virginia. 

(U.S Marine Corps photo by Sgt. Reece Lodder)
